0022600218.text: The Knicks, now 6-4 and riding a four-game winning streak, host the Cavaliers (5-6, on a two-game skid) in New York's 11th game of the 2026-27 season. New York is 4-2 at home and sits 3rd in the Atlantic, 2.5 games back and 4th in the East, while Cleveland is 1-4 on the road, 2nd in the Central, 2.5 games back and 7th in the East. Josh Hart is out for the Knicks with illness, and Karl-Anthony Towns is day-to-day with calf soreness and a game-time decision, while the Cavaliers are without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Sam Merrill (elbow). The Knicks lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 109-97 win in Cleveland on November 7, and they also won the 2025-26 series 2-1 and the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0.
